faq.question: Which software do you detail in?
faq.answer: Tekla Structures 2026, with models shared through Trimble Connect when you want to follow progress or review in 3D.

faq.question: Can we see sample drawings?
faq.answer: Yes. A sample of our miscellaneous steel work (stairs, handrails and platforms) is on this page. Samples for structural steel buildings, pipe racks, industrial structures and other types of projects are available on request.

faq.question: Can you work to our shop standards?
faq.answer: Yes. Send your Tekla templates, title block, piece-mark scheme, bolt and weld conventions and a sample set. We set them up before the first sheet is drawn.

faq.question: What do you need to quote a job?
faq.answer: Contract drawings (PDF or DWG), specifications, any addenda, your shop standards and the schedule you are working to. A scope and a schedule come back with our first questions.

faq.question: How do you handle questions on the contract documents?
faq.answer: Questions go out early as written RFIs with sketches and references to the contract drawings. Nothing is guessed, and every answer is tracked into the model.

faq.question: Do you provide CNC and DXF files?
faq.answer: Yes. DSTV/NC1 files for saws and drill lines, and DXF files for plate cutting, exported from the same model as the drawings.

faq.question: How are revisions handled?
faq.answer: Revisions are clouded and listed in the revision block, and only the affected sheets are re-issued, so your shop can see exactly what changed.

faq.question: Which time zone do you work in?
faq.answer: Our offices in Cairo and Sidon are 7 to 10 hours ahead of US time. Markups sent at the end of your day are worked while your shop is closed.
